name: Criofan
text: Criofan is a modern variant spelling of Crimthann. The older name means fox and was common in early Ireland. Kings, heroes of the Fenian band, and one saint carried it. MacKillop lists the form beside Crimthan, Criomthann, and Cremthann. Readers should follow the Crimthann entry for its famous bearers.

okr.objective: Route readers of the modern form Criofan to the main Crimthann entry.
key_results: MacKillop gives Criofan as a modern spelling of Crimthann.
Crimthann means fox and was borne by kings, Fianna figures, and a saint.
